title: Big Lots Recalls Floor Lamps Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The wiring for the lamp's light sockets can become exposed, posing a risk of electric shock to consumers. In addition, use of the recommended standard 40 watt light bulbs can generate excessive heat, which can melt the double plastic shades over the bulbs. Units: About 43,700.

title: Kaz USA Recalls Honeywell Portable Electric Heaters Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The heater's internal housing, including the fan, heating element and circuitry, can detach, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 19,000.

title: Chariot Carriers Recalls Child Bicycle Trailers and Conversion Kits Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The bicycle trailer's hitch mechanisms can crack and break, causing the trailer to detach from the bicycle. This poses an injury hazard to children in the bicycle trailer. Units: About 44,000 bicycle trailers and 70,000 bicycle trailer conversion kits.

title: Demdaco Recalls Carruth Candleholder Collection Tea Light Candles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The tea light can burn with an excessive flame height, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 5,480.

title: The Land of Nod Recalls Bed Frames Due to Entrapment Hazard
summary: A child's torso can become lodged in the gap between the footboard's top rail and the mattress, posing an entrapment hazard to the child. Units: About 1,600 units.

title: Bicycle Helmets Recalled by Triple Eight Distribution Due to Risk of Head Injury
summary: Product testing demonstrated that these helmets do not comply with CPSC safety standards for impact resistance. Consumers could suffer impact head injuries in a fall. Units: About 30,400.

title: Children's Chairs and Stools Recalled by Elegant Gifts Mart Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The yellow surface paint on the metal frame of the children's chairs and stools contains excessive levels of lead which is prohibited under federal law. Units: About 1,600 chairs and 1,300 stools.

title: IKEA Recalls to Repair High Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: he high chair's restraint buckle can open unexpectedly, posing a fall hazard to the child Units: About 169,000 (133,000 in the U.S. and 36,000 in Canada).

title: Sterno Recalls Tea Lights Due to Fire and Burn Hazard
summary: The tea light wax can overheat resulting in the wax catching fire, posing a burn and fire hazard. Units: About 10,000 cases.

title: Target Recalls LED Flashlight Sets Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: When turned on, the flashlights can heat up, smoke or melt, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 55,000.

title: Bicycle Pedals Recalled by Performance Inc. Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The pedal body can break or crack during use, causing the rider to lose control and posing a fall hazard. Units: About 2,900.

title: Uni-O Industries Recalls O-Grill Portable Gas Grills Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The regulator on the grill can leak gas which can ignite, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,530.

title: BJ's Recalls LED Flashlight Sets Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The flashlights can heat up, smoke or melt when turned on, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 41,000.

title: Columbia ParCar Recalls for Repair Golf, Service, Utility Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The lower steering yoke can loosen where it attaches to the steering rack and pinion, causing the driver to lose control of the vehicle and crash. Units: About 1,400.

title: KYMCO Recalls Utility Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An exposed portion of the exhaust system can allow debris such as leaves, brush or other flammable materials to enter the opening and ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,876.

title: Bicycle Handlebars Recalled by Euro Asia Imports; Handlebars Can Break Resulting in Loss of Control and Fall Hazard
summary: The recalled bicycle handlebars can break while the user is riding the bike, resulting in loss of control and a fall hazard. Units: About 2,000 in the United States and 70 in Canada.

title: Blount International Recalls Replacement Blades Used with Ariens Lawnmowers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The replacement lawnmower blades can break during normal use, posing a laceration hazard to the user and bystanders. Units: About 950.

title: Infant Rattles Recalled by Lee Carter Co. Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The rattle's handle is small enough to fit into a child's throat, posing a choking hazard and violating federal rattle standards. Units: About 25,000.

title: Mexican Wrestling Action Figures Recalled by Lee Carter Co. Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The surface paints on the action figures contain excessive levels of lead which is prohibited under federal law. Units: About 7,000 packs.

title: Expandable Lunch Boxes Recalled by California Innovations Due to Freezer Gel Pack Ingestion Hazard
summary: Gel that contains diethylene glycol and ethylene glycol can leak out of damaged freezer gel packs, posing a poisoning hazard if ingested by children or adults. Units: About 248,000.

title: Food Carriers Recalled by California Innovations Due to Freezer Gel Pack Ingestion Hazard
summary: Gel that contains diethylene glycol and ethylene glycol can leak out of damaged freezer gel packs, posing a poisoning hazard if ingested by children or adults. Units: About 55,000.

title: Giant Bicycle Recalls Two Models; Forks Can Break Causing Fall Hazard
summary: The fork can crack, posing a fall hazard to riders. Units: About 900.

title: Steelcase Inc. Recalls Desk Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The pivot pins installed in the control mechanism under the chair seat can fall out, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 11,000.

title: Hy Cite Enterprises Recalls Royal Prestige Thermal Wall Pots and Pans Due to Burn and Fire Hazard
summary: The cookware can collapse, crimp or severely deform when exposed to heat, posing a burn and fire hazard to the consumer and nearby property. Units: About 1.7 million.

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The lower steering tie-rod attachment can loosen and cause loss of steering control, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 19,000 (This recall was first announced in December 2011).

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Expands Recall of Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The brake component housed within the bicycle's carbon fork can disengage from the fork and allow the brake assembly to contact the wheel spokes while rotating, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 460 (About 14,200 were recalled in September 2011).
